steps: Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Number of observations
Arrange the data in ascending order: 8, 12, 15, 15, 19, 22, 25
Median = Middle value of the ordered data

Mode = Value that occurs most often
15 occurs twice, more often than any other value: Mode = 15
